prose: Bloomberg reports Samsung expects capital expenditure to rise about 60 percent to roughly $63 billion this year, with HBM memory capacity sold out through 2027 and ten long-term supply deals secured with key customers. The spending hike follows a chip profit that missed estimates but was lifted by resurgent AI demand.
highlights: Samsung capex to rise ~60% to ~$63B this year
Ten long-term supply deals secured with key customers
Chip profit missed estimates, lifted by AI demand hopes
basis: The fetch failed with HTTP 403 (Bloomberg bot-block), so this entry is based on the Techmeme feed summary and headline.
